description: POLISH A MIX: a mix preset is a model trained on finished, professionally mixed recordings. It covers YOUR mix and folds what it hears back in by frequency range. preset: "cinematic_score" (the default) = a whole orchestral / film-score mix, the tone and width of a finished score moved onto yours, below 8 kHz, with none of the model's own audio heard. Input: audio_url (a doseedo_mix mix_url as returned) or audio_key, a stereo mix of up to 10 minutes. The preset brings its own strength; cns (0.1–0.5) overrides it: how much of your mix's own sound the model's take keeps (higher = closer to the input). Async: job_id → doseedo_wait_task (~15–90 s) → mix_url (the polished mix, WAV), take_url (the model's raw take) and report: balance_vs_input_db per band and side_vs_input_db (the width change). Cancel: the plane has no stop for a running mix preset — it runs to completion (credits spent), the job ends as canceled and its output is discarded. Only a job still queued at the plane is refunded by the plane's own failure refund.

audio_key.description: R2 ingest key of an uploaded audio file (from doseedo_get_upload_url / POST /api/upload/r2/ingest-url; starts with "ingest/").

audio_url.description: https URL of the audio, as an alternative to audio_key: a doseedo result URL exactly as a job returned it (a stem, a take, a bounce), or any public URL. The gateway fetches it (≤256 MB) into your account's ingest storage before the job starts. Pass audio_key OR audio_url.

cns.description: The model's strength over the preset's own: how much of the input's own sound its take keeps (0.1–0.5, higher = closer to the input).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Any unique string for THIS request (e.g. a UUID). Re-sending the same call with the same key after a timeout returns the same job instead of starting a second one.

name.description: Optional: a name for this job's files, e.g. "rainy-loop-3". Every file it returns downloads as <name>_<part>.<ext> (rainy-loop-3_Celesta.wav, rainy-loop-3_rough-mix.wav; one take: rainy-loop-3.wav), so the user can find them. Give each job its own name (a second take: "rainy-loop-3b"). Default: doseedo-<last 6 characters of the job id>.

preset.description: The mix preset: "cinematic_score" (default) — a whole orchestral / film-score mix.

name: doseedo_mix_preset
title: Polish a mix with a mix preset
